name: Pulsetic Free
free_limit: Hosted uptime monitoring Free plan: 10 shared monitors/heartbeats/domains with checks every 5 minutes from 3 regions, 3 hosted status pages including custom domains, 1,000 real-user monitoring page views per month, email alerts and 3 months of uptime history.
watch_out: The 10-monitor allowance is shared across monitor/heartbeat/domain resources, not 10 of each. RUM has a 1,000-page-view monthly allowance; 5-minute checks and 3-month retention apply. Faster checks, extra monitors, advanced status-page customization, API/MCP integrations and SMS/call/WhatsApp alerts require paid plans or paid add-ons. No free hosted compute or infrastructure is included.
